mapper.sql:
with CET as( SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, C.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, A.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID parentCustomerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, y.item_value creditQuoteTypeValue, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE creditQuoteTypeCode, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE creditQuoteType, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK creditQuoteRank, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt, A.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('01','04') left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.CUSTOMER_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID,sum(CREDIT_AMT) as TRADE_AMT from( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID,CREDIT_AMT,row_number() over (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID,c.CREDIT_MST_ID ORDER BY c.CDATE DESC) as newResult FROM CREDIT_LINES_PIERCE c where to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= c.CDATE ) c where c.newResult =1) GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID) E on A.CUSTOMER_ID= E.CUSTOMER_ID and A.CREDIT_MST_ID= E.CREDIT_MST_ID
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY A.PFLSH DESC ,A.SEQNO ASC,A.CREDIT_AMT DESC )

if.test: parentId == null or parentId == '' or parentId=='root'.toString()

select.if:
select SEQNO, null creditMstId, customerId, customerName, PFLSH, null creditQuoteTypeValue, creditAmt, VDATE, MDATE, usedAmt, usedEnstustAmt, usedAmtTotal, remainAmt, '02' hasChildren, 'root' parentInfo, CONCAT(PFLSH, customerId) childInfo, institutionCode from CET
parentCustomerId is null

if.test: parentId != null and parentId != '' and parentId!='root'.toString() and parentId!='export'.toString()

select.if: select SEQNO, creditMstId, customerId, customerName, PFLSH, creditQuoteTypeValue, creditAmt, VDATE, MDATE, usedAmt, usedEnstustAmt, usedAmtTotal, remainAmt, institutionCode from CET

mapper.select:
SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_NAME as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt, A.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('02') inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID,sum(CREDIT_AMT) as TRADE_AMT from( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID,CREDIT_AMT,row_number() over (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID,c.CREDIT_MST_ID ORDER BY c.CDATE DESC) as newResult FROM CREDIT_LINES_PIERCE c where to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= c.CDATE ) c where c.newResult =1) GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID) E on A.CUSTOMER_ID= E.CUSTOMER_ID and A.CREDIT_MST_ID= E.CREDIT_MST_ID
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by A.VDATE desc

select MM.* from ( SELECT 'root' as pid, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt, '02' as hasChildren, A.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('03') inner join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.SEQNO AS SEQNO, SUM(CREDIT_AMT) AS TRADE_AMT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CREDIT_MST_ID, CREDIT_AMT, row_number() over (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID,c.CREDIT_MST_ID ORDER BY c.CDATE DESC) AS newResult FROM CREDIT_LINES_PIERCE c WHERE to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= c.CDATE ) c WHERE c.newResult =1) c,CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL where c.CUSTOMER_ID =CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.FINPROD_ID and CREDIT_MST_ID = '0002' GROUP BY CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.SEQNO) E ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=E.SEQNO union all
SELECT A.SEQNO pid, A.FINPROD_ID customerId, A.PFLSH AS PFLSH, NULL AS creditAmt, B.VDATE VDATE, B.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_ABBR as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, null as remainAmt, '01' as hasChildren, B.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode FROM (select m.seqno,m.finprod_id,n.pflsh from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL m inner join CREDIT_LINES n on m.seqno=n.customer_id) A inner join CREDIT_LINES B on A.FINPROD_ID=B.CUSTOMER_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on B.SEQNO=D.SEQNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, SUM(CREDIT_AMT) AS TRADE_AMT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CREDIT_MST_ID, CREDIT_AMT, row_number() over (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID,c.CREDIT_MST_ID ORDER BY c.CDATE DESC ) AS newResult FROM CREDIT_LINES_PIERCE c WHERE to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= c.CDATE ) c WHERE c.newResult =1) c,CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL where c.CUSTOMER_ID =CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.FINPROD_ID and CREDIT_MST_ID = '0002' GROUP BY CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL.FINPROD_ID) E ON A.FINPROD_ID=E.FINPROD_ID ) MM
MM.customerId IN (#{item} )
AND MM.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_char(MM.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = to_char(MM.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by MM.VDATE desc
